_README: Brent term structure snapshot, taken Monday when markets reopen. Backwardation (M1 > deferred) = physical tightness. Backwardation EASING (spread shrinking toward 0 / flipping to contango) = tightness relaxing before any headline says so. Update 'curve' each Monday with front-month settlement out to M6, and append the M1-M3 spread to 'spread_history'. Source used: NYMEX Brent Last Day Financial (BZ) contract closes via Yahoo Finance (tickers BZF27.NYM … BZM27.NYM), which track ICE Brent settlements; cross-check with ICE / Barchart. Seed history replaced 2026-11-08. Earlier Mondays could not be reconstructed: the Dec-26 contract that was M1 until 30 Oct has expired and its history is no longer served.
